narr: Monsoonal moisture remained over southern New Mexico as a weak upper trough was lifting out of southern Arizona. Numerous showers and thunderstorms developed over the higher terrain of the Gila region which brought flash flooding to the Monticello area.
ev: Several videos from a spotter as well as verbal confirmation of flash flooding near Highway 142.
